package rulefixtures

import (
	"os"
)

// scenario for string_concatenation_for_path_join: `dir + "/" + file` or manual path assembly via `+` concatenation
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func scenario646Positive(baseDir string) (string, error) {
	configPath := baseDir + "/config" + "/app.yaml"
	data, err := os.ReadFile(configPath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	logPath := baseDir + "/logs" + "/error.log"
	os.WriteFile(logPath, data, 0644)

	return configPath, nil
}
